brand.name: Suhbah
brand.sector: Shared worship tracker app for Muslims

sentence.en: Two people, one arc. Log your prayers and watch your day fill up together.

set.name: After Isha
set.mechanism: The arc as light in the night sky: a turquoise half and a saffron half glowing on deep midnight, for an app most used before Fajr and after Isha.
set.expression_move: The dark midnight ground is the loud move; type and layout stay quiet.
set.differs_by: Every named competitor is light and green. A dark first identity with two light colours stands apart on the home screen.

logo.concept: The same arc, drawn in light on a night ground.

rationale.claim: The arc mark and both typefaces are kept from the app as the founder approved them; only the colours change between sets.
Teal and yellow are vivid only when light, so they need the dark partner ground.

findings.message: light: primary #3cc2c4 on background #ffffff is 2.16:1, below 3.0:1 (primary fill against the page (needs a label or border if lower); WCAG 2, no rounding)
light: accent #ffc94d on background #ffffff is 1.53:1, below 3.0:1 (accent fill against the page (needs a label or border if lower); WCAG 2, no rounding)
#3cc2c4 and #ffc94d are both saturated (C* 36/67) with almost equal lightness (Delta L* 11.8); edges between them vibrate and text on either is unreadable

suggested_fix.how: lighten by OKLCH L +0.01, same hue

findings.message: brand and action colours span only Delta L* 11.8; without a clear light/dark step between them the palette reads flat (lightness contrast is the strongest harmony predictor, O'Donovan 2011)

suggested_fix.how: move the accent (not a locked brand colour) at least 25 L* away from the primary

findings.message: light: ext-1 #f096ba is 2.15:1 on the light background #ffffff; as a stripe, chart series or thin line it needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)

suggested_fix.how: use ext-1-600 for stripes, chart series and thin lines

findings.message: light: border #e5e6e9 on background #ffffff is 1.25:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: link #3cc2c4 on text #f2f3f5 is 1.95:1, below 3.0:1 (underline links in dark mode (WCAG G183: without underline a link needs 3:1 against body text); WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: border #505561 on background #141e38 is 2.21:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
#ffc94d sits at the sRGB gamut edge (100% of max chroma); vivid colours like this often fall outside CMYK process gamut: specify Lab D50 + tolerance, check with the printer, consider a spot colour
#3cc2c4 and #ffc94d differ by only Delta L* 11.8; side by side in a logo they merge in greyscale/one-colour print
